lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pd₄Al₄Sn₄ (reduced formula PdAlSn) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Al and Sn each have 8 Pd neighbors, while Pd has 4 Al and 4 Sn neighbors, all at 2.7154 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among like-centered 8-vertex Al and Sn polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Al- and Sn-centered polyhedra.
